### Visualization
```{r}
# Load your data (correct way)
compmus_data <- read.csv("compmus2025.csv") # Make sure the file path is correct

# Check your data
print(head(compmus_data))
str(compmus_data)

# Correct way to use the pipe with ggplot2 (using a tibble or data frame)
compmus_data %>%  # Start with the data frame
  ggplot(aes(
    x = tempo,
    y = arousal,
    size = instrumentalness,
    colour = danceability
  )) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_rug(linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_text(
    x = 121,
    y = 4.91,
    label = "Onda Corta - Sud America",
    size = 3,
    hjust = "left",
    vjust = "center",
    angle = 30
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(50, 200),
    breaks = c(50, 100, 150, 200),
    minor_breaks = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(1, 9),
    breaks = c(1, 5, 9),
    minor_breaks = NULL
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c() +
  scale_size_continuous(
    trans = "exp",
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    x = "Tempo",
    y = "Arousal",
    colour = "Danceability"
  )
```
